name: Headwater Crash
description: Drop the weight of the first water through one fist onto the target and its guard.

name: Headwater Veil
description: Wear a veil of first water round the body that thins every strike that touches it.

name: Headwater Mend
description: Pour first water over an ally until deep wounds seal and the bone beneath them sets.

name: Headwater Revival
description: Let the first water run over a person whose breath has just stopped and wake the heart.

name: Headwater Seal
description: Lock a foe's whole qi system under first water so nothing in it can stir for a span.

name: Headwater Absorb
description: Take a heavy strike into the first water and keep the force as reserve.

name: Headwater Passage
description: Flow through a barrier or a body as water and re-form whole on the far side.

name: Headwater Siphon
description: Draw the qi out of a foe back toward the headwater until the foe is hollow and slow.

name: Headwater Crown
description: Raise the school's headwater in three beats of pull and crush and wash that end on the target.

name: Headwater Embrace
description: Wrap every ally in reach in first water that closes wounds and renews the spent reserve.

name: Headwater Deluge
description: Pour the headwater over the field with force at the destructive ceiling of the user's tier.

name: First Water
description: Call the water that ran before any shore so one wound or ruin it touches is washed back to unharmed.

name: Primeval Crush
description: Bring the primeval water down through a single fist with the weight of the world's first depth.

name: Primeval Drowning
description: Spread a field of primeval water over the ground that drags every opponent in it beneath the surface.

name: Primeval Wash
description: Wash an ally in primeval water that lifts out poison and curse and soul erosion at once.

name: Primeval Mend
description: Pour primeval water into an ally until the worst injuries close and the strength returns.

name: Primeval Seal
description: Hold a foe under primeval water so nothing in the foe's qi can stir for a long span.

name: Primeval Reversal
description: Turn the primeval water against a ruinous strike and fling its force back on the sender.

name: Primeval Flash
description: Dissolve into primeval water and re-form at the far edge of the field in an instant.

name: Primeval Spear
description: Compress primeval water to a single hard spear that pierces guard and armour and flesh.

name: Primeval Crown
description: Raise the school's primeval water in three beats of pull and crush and cleansing wash.

name: Primeval Rite
description: Perform the school's rite of the first depth and let it guard and heal those who stand inside it.

name: Primeval Embrace
description: Wrap every ally in reach in primeval water that closes wounds and fills the spent reserve.

name: Primeval Flood
description: Raise the primeval water over the whole field with force at the destructive ceiling of the user's tier.

name: Sovereign Water
description: Bind all water in sight to the user's will including the water inside living bodies so none moves unbidden.

name: Tideless Return
description: Unmake one ruin that water has wrought as if the flood had never risen and return those it drowned.
